releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v7.6.0 — Direct DWM Composition Bypass (Hardware Flip Model Enforcer):
- Direct DWM Composition Bypass: Enforces true DirectFlip and Hardware Independent Flip presentation (GameDVR_FSEBehaviorMode = 2, DwmEnableMMCSS = 1, Flip Queue Size = 1) across all windowed and borderless games.
- Eliminates DWM Compositing Delay: Bypasses DWM backpressure and saves 2W–4W of idle DWM composition load while cutting input latency.
- Dynamic Power Budget Ratio Optimizer: Auto-shifts up to 85W Max TGP to the RTX 4060 when GPU-bound.
- Resolution Scale & FSR/NIS Automator.
- Kernel DPC Latency Watchdog & audiodg.exe Pro-Audio Lock.
